name: houdini_apply
description: A revision-checked graph intent of 1 to 50 typed operations: node.create, node.rename, parm.set_value (numbers and booleans), graph.connect, graph.delete. Dry run by default; dry_run false with confirm true applies it, with permission, as one undo group (restored on failure). expect: preconditions. Needs Houdini's interface (refused in hython). For anything else, houdini_execute_code.

if_revision.description: The revision of your last houdini_context.

command_id.description: Idempotent ID: a replay applies nothing twice.

operations.description: {op, ...}: node.create {parent, type, name?, bind?}, node.rename {target, name}, parm.set_value {target, value}, graph.connect {source, destination, input_index?}, graph.delete {target}. $alias names a node created earlier in the intent.

expect.description: {subject, predicate: exists, name_equals, value_equals, connected_to, value?}
